frozen_entry_rule.eligibility: registered retrace-kill rule (entries stop after confirmed closes below base+0.5*(running_high-base) for max(3min, 10% of pump age))
frozen_entry_rule.classifier_gate: p_cont >= per-OOS-week median of p_cont, where p_cont = 1 - calibrated fade probability from the pooled-ordinal weekly walk-forward
frozen_entry_rule.d_max_cap: NONE — development quartile analysis showed near-base stops lose and far-base large pumps carry the continuation convexity; a d_max cap would remove the edge
frozen_entry_rule.exposure: max one concurrent position per recurrence_chain_id
